layers.process: Tibetan settlements at Bylakuppe (Dickey Larsoe and Lugsung Samdupling), Mundgod (Doeguling), Kollegal (Dhondenling) and Hunsur (Rabgayling), and the Atisha Charitable Trust land near Mysuru, are Restricted Areas under the Fourth Schedule of India's Immigration and Foreigners Order 2025. Daytime visits are allowed without a permit if the settlement, monastery or institute gives the visitor's name, parentage, date of birth, nationality, passport and visa numbers to the Foreigners Registration Officer. Staying needs a Restricted Area Permit; foreign students can get one valid for 3 years if the institute vouches for them.
